Extension · Bibliography

Citation Workbench

Turns on citation analysis, duplicate detection, stale-reference warnings, and BibTeX helpers.

What it adds

  • Project bibliography
  • Citation assistant
  • Missing citations
  • Unused bibliography entries
  • Duplicate references
  • Broken links
  • Citation key suggestions
  • Reference metadata import
  • Old citation warnings
  • Snippet: Annotated BibTeX note

Tags

  • bibtex
  • citations
  • references

Details

  • Version 1.0.0
  • By LatexDo
  • Identifier latexdo.citation-workbench

Install Citation Workbench

In LatexDo, open the Extensions view, find Citation Workbench and choose Install. It is free.
